mapper.select: WITH HOLD_RULE AS( SELECT #{eqpG,jdbcType=VARCHAR} EQP_G,#{moduleOwner,jdbcType=VARCHAR} MODULE_OWNER,#{opeNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OPE_NO ,#{rule,jdbcType=VARCHAR} RULE,#{sdeptId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SDEPT_ID,#{location,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LOCATION ,#{tech,jdbcType=VARCHAR} TECH,'static' UPDATE_FLAG,#{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER,SYSDATE UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL ) SELECT A.EQP_G,A.MODULE_OWNER,A.RULE,A.SDEPT_ID,A.LOCATION,C.MODULE FROM HOLD_RULE A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.HOLD_TO_SDEPT_RULE B ON A.EQP_G = B.EQP_G AND A.MODULE_OWNER = B.MODULE_OWNER AND A.LOCATION = B.LOCATION LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT EQP_G,MODULE,'N1A1'LOCATION FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD UNION SELECT DISTINCT EQP_G,MODULE,'N1A3'LOCATION FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 )C ON A.EQP_G = C.EQP_G WHERE B.EQP_G IS NULL AND ROWNUM = 1
